entities.name: Emilio Núñez Portuondo

entities.summary: Emilio Núñez Portuondo was a Cuban politician, lawyer, and diplomat. He was the 13th Prime Minister of Cuba in 1958. He received the National Order of the Legion of Honour of France among other decorations from many countries.
